ota.summary: Innovo RedBox Fury Garage 2026.09.23.01 - adds per-door Open Travel Time and Close Travel Time (5-60s, default 15) for doors 1-4. A single reed switch cannot report Opening or Closing: it leaves 'closed' a second into travel and never reports arrival at fully open. Clients use these to derive motion state. Door 5 is sensor-only and has none.
